# Truestead Law, LLC
> Florida law firm — Personal Injury, Real Estate, Wills/Estates/Trusts, and Elder Law. Founder Arthur Simpson, Esq. (Florida Bar #529265). Serving Florida statewide; based in Ormond Beach, Volusia County. "Built to last. Planned to pass on."

## Core Practice Areas
- [Personal Injury](https://truesteadlaw.com/personal-injury): Florida accident & injury claims; co-counsel litigation; free case review.
- [Real Estate Law](https://truesteadlaw.com/real-estate): deeds, title, homestead, ownership structure, disputes.
- [Wills, Estates & Trusts](https://truesteadlaw.com/estate-planning): wills, revocable & irrevocable trusts, probate avoidance, homestead.
- [Elder Law](https://truesteadlaw.com/elder-law): Medicaid & long-term-care planning, guardianship, incapacity.

## Florida Estate Kit (online documents)
- [Florida Estate Kit](https://truesteadlaw.com/florida-estate-kit): Florida-specific estate documents online — DIY from $399 or attorney-guided. Real Florida documents, plain English.
- [18 & Protected (FREE)](https://truesteadlaw.com/18-and-protected): free Florida legal packet for young adults 18–25 — Health Care Surrogate, HIPAA authorization, Durable Power of Attorney, and FERPA waiver, with a signing checklist. For parents of new 18-year-olds / college students.
